user.title: Connect to Anova
user.description: Enter the email and password for the Anova account the oven is registered to (the same login as the Anova app). This connects to Anova's cloud service — the Precision Oven has no local API.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter Anova password
reauth_confirm.description: Anova's cloud rejected the stored password for {email}. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Anova's cloud service.

abort.already_configured: This Anova account is already configured.

init.title: Favorite recipes
init.description: One switch per recipe, in addition to the always-present Power switch. Edit as JSON — same stage-graph shape as the plugin's config.json.example.

error.invalid_recipes: That isn't valid recipes JSON — check it's a non-empty list of {name, stages} objects.
